title: Bedrock Debris Parity
description: Makes it so that Ancient Debris generates in the same amount it does on Bedrock Edition
body:
Makes ancient debris attempt the same amount of generations as it does in bedrock edition.

In vanilla:
- One cluster of size 0-3 attempts generation
- One cluster of 0-2 attempts generation

With this datapack:
- Two clusters of size 0-3 attempts generation
- Three clusters of 0-2 attempts generation
